text:
Maria Chen: quick heads-up — press slate for the new benchmark post + webinar is penciled for Thurs 10am PT. want to align the launch email + a short nurture (2 emails) for inbound signups. thoughts?
Samir Patel: can we tie the first email to the blog + a CTA to register for the webinar? keeps traffic consolidated. also need a timely subject line.
Devin O'Neal: +1. segment inbound by "product interest" tag and source (organic vs paid). high-intent (docs/benchmark page) get immediate invite; others go into 48hr nurture.
Lee Wong: ops note — if we route high-intent leads, we need the webhook to tag them with "slate_hs" so sales can follow. can someone confirm event name for tracking?
Priya Shah: creative: I can do two modular templates: 1) launch/press-style (short header, 3 bullets, register CTA) 2) nurture (case highlight + replay CTA). need final subject + hero image by Weds EOD.
Samir Patel: draft subject candidates: "New benchmark: LLM inference at scale — read the results", "Benchmark released + live webinar Thurs", "How we cut token cost by 3x — benchmark + demo". A/B which one?
Devin O'Neal: prefer the second + test the third as B. B-targeting to devs/infra folks.
Maria Chen: decision: send A="Benchmark released + live webinar Thurs" to general list, B=third subject to dev-infra segment. Priya, go ahead with hero for both.
Lee Wong: tagging event name: use utm_campaign=slate_press_2025 and sales tag "slate_hs". webhook payload example: ```{
  "lead_id": "{{id}}",
  "tags": ["slate_hs"],
  "source": "benchmark-page"
}```
Samir Patel: schedule: first send (announce + register) Thurs 10am PT, follow-up reminder Fri 9am PT to registrants who haven't watched. nurture email to non-registrants goes out 48hrs after first send.
Priya Shah: creatives timeline noted. I'll upload two hero options to the drive: image A (hero photo) and image B (chart snapshot). link: https://drive.redwood/example-slategfx
Devin O'Neal: segmentation details: lists -> all_marketing; filters -> interested_in=benchmark OR visited=/benchmarks; dev_infra = visited=/benchmarks/docs OR utm_medium=dev-bench. export by 6am Thurs PT.
Maria Chen: tracking & analytics: assign UTM and event names to the tracking doc. Samir, can you own the analytics dashboard so we can watch open->register conversions in real time?
Samir Patel: yep I'll spin up a simple dashboard. will include: open rate, CTR to register, webinar regs, playback views. dashboard link will be in the thread once created.
marketing-bot: Calendar event created: "Slate launch + webinar" Thu 10:00 PT — invite sent to #marketing, #product, #growth.
Lee Wong: ops check — deliverability? should we throttle sends for EU recipients? timezone split: US/CA send Thurs 10am PT, EU send Fri 10am CET. Asia hold for Monday.
Maria Chen: good call. let's do timezone splits. Priya — include localized date/time strings in templates.
Priya Shah: will do. also prepping alt copy for APAC timezone.
Devin O'Neal: reminder: set the canary rollout for the A/B subjects at 10% for first 10 minutes to monitor bounces/spikes.
Lee Wong: noted, will configure canary in ESP. also configuring retries for webhook failures.
Samir Patel: quick copy ask: one-liner for the hero (20-30 chars) and a 90-char preheader. I can draft if helpful.
Maria Chen: Samir pls draft hero line + preheader and post here. I'll review then hand to Priya.
Samir Patel: hero: "Benchmark: inference at production scale"; preheader: "See how we optimized latency, cost, and throughput — live demo Thurs".
Maria Chen: perfect. final owners: Samir copy + analytics, Priya creative, Devin segmentation + exports, Lee ops/webhooks. I'll own send timing and overall launch.
Devin O'Neal: I'll export segments and confirm CSV to Lee by 6am Thurs PT.
Priya Shah: uploading mockups now. https://drive.redwood/example-slategfx/imageA.png
marketing-bot: Reminder: Design assets due by 2025-03-19T23:59:00Z.
Maria Chen: last note — please add UTM tag param set in the tracking doc like: utm_source=newsletter, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=slate_press_2025. keep consistent.
Samir Patel: done. I'll post dashboard link when ready.
Lee Wong: ops will enable canary + timezone split and confirm when scheduled.
Maria Chen: thanks team — small but focused cadence. we'll reconvene if anything blocks. :rocket:
